levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Assigns vague homes, such as "in the closet somewhere," for one or more items.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Assigns one exact, specific home for every one of the five items.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Assigns exact homes and explains why a specific home was chosen based on how often that item is used.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Recalls fewer than three of the five item-and-home pairs from memory.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Recalls four or five of the five item-and-home pairs from memory.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Recalls all five pairs and explains what made one specific home easy to remember.

lookFors: The reflection names a specific before location and a specific after location, not a vague "it's better now."
Homes chosen are places the learner can realistically reach without help.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
